decisions.notes: Victorian armchair is coherent from every orbit, top and underside. Carved wood and upholstery read clearly, PBR maps are intact, and the validator reports no errors. One zero-area triangle is negligible for a static realistic chair variant.
limitations: One zero-area triangle retained from upstream.

decisions.notes: Potted zebra succulent is complete from all sides, top and bottom, with pot, soil and leaves coherent. PBR maps are preserved, no zero-area triangles and no validator errors. Strong realistic plant variant alongside the approved potted plant.
limitations: Generated tangent-space and buffer-view-target warnings are non-visual.
Leaf geometry is moderately dense; use LODs for large scenes.

decisions.notes: Stylized barbarian reads cleanly from every angle with weapons, armor and cape attachments intact. Atlas texture is preserved, rig is present, no zero-area triangles and no validator errors. Consistent kids'/fantasy human variant.
limitations: Skinned-mesh non-root and buffer-view-target warnings are non-visual.
Rest-pose inspection only; animation import must be tested in the target engine.

decisions.notes: Mini male character is complete and readable from all sides, with simple rig and colormap intact. No zero-area triangles and no validator errors. Good low-poly human variant for kids' games and a deliberate contrast to realistic humans.
limitations: Flat-color colormap rather than PBR maps.

decisions.notes: Sports sedan is complete from front, back, sides, top and underside, with wheels and body coherent. Flat-color atlas suits the stylized vehicle category. Thirteen zero-area triangles are minor for a low-poly static prop and do not break the silhouette.
limitations: Thirteen zero-area triangles retained from upstream.
Flat-color atlas rather than PBR maps.

decisions.notes: Sprinkled donut is complete and readable from every angle, with icing and sprinkles intact. Flat-color atlas suits kids' food props. No zero-area triangles or validator errors. Useful stylized food variant.
limitations: Flat-color atlas rather than PBR maps.
Intentionally low-poly; not a realistic food substitute.
